requirement.evidence: The Office of Landlord Tenant Relations administers and enforces the Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260 of the Jersey City Municipal Code
requirement.note: The document supports the Office, Chapter 260, SeeClickFix status inquiry, and the Illegal Rent Petition. It does not say that buildings with 5 or more units are regulated; it only says 1-4 unit properties are exempt, and exemptions beyond that exist. The 'may be regulated' wording is a reasonable hedge.
